resources.string:
This Gym Workout App is designed to help users plan their workouts, track progress, and calculate BMI.

 The app includes structured workout days such as:
 • Chest Day – focuses on chest, shoulders, and triceps.
 • Back Day – targets the back and biceps.
 • Leg Day – strengthens the lower body including quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves.

 To support muscle growth and recovery, users are encouraged to consume protein-rich foods such as:
 • Chicken breast and grilled turkey
 • Eggs (boiled or scrambled)
 • Fish like salmon and tuna
 • Milk, yogurt, and low-fat cheese
 • Beans, lentils, and chickpeas
 • Tofu and tempeh
 • Nuts, peanuts, and peanut butter
 • Protein shakes or whey protein

 This app helps users maintain a healthy, balanced, and active fitness lifestyle.
